briefs.claim_en: Prime Minister Modi is giving all Indians 3 months of free mobile recharge.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple fact-checking organizations and government sources, including PIB Fact Check, have debunked the claim that Prime Minister Modi is offering three months of free mobile recharge to all Indian citizens. These sources, published between March 2023 and September 2026, state that no such scheme exists and warn against fraudulent links. Some reports, like one from newsonair.gov.in on August 18, 2026, specifically mention that viral videos making this claim are AI-generated. Vishvas News, BOOM, and FACTLY have also rated similar claims as false, often linking them to various events or schemes.
